## Bright Smile booking tool
Vapi calls this webhook when the agent uses the book_appointment tool.
- date_time must be ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-11-19T10:00:00)
- Calendar is set to "primary": switch to a test calendar while testing
- Failure path still replies so the agent never goes silent
